angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 88,510,433 km at 137.55 pc = 8.6 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 98688: distance 137.552 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.025), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 137.552 +/- 3.439 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 7.2677 +/- 0.2610 mas (same row, RUWE 2.53), 27.8 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 127.225 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 98688: radius 127.225 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 2214.86 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.075) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 88,510,433 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 3513 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 98688: effective temperature 3513 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.259) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 98688: effective temperature 3513 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.259) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, * c Sgr: spectral type M4.5III (1989ApJS...71..245K)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, * c Sgr: projected rotation speed 17.8 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2023ApJS..266...11B)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.

surfaceGravitySource: log g 0.28 from 2023ApJS..266...11B; the 1 published value span log g 0.278 to 0.278, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..266...11B)
